VOT.note: Experts report their rankings by perceived quality; they are not modelled as strategic.

ORG.quote_behav: The goal of the planner is now to construct a committee
ORG.quote_info: the planner cannot observe candidates’ qualities
ORG.note: The planner chooses the committee and the voting rule to minimise worst-case regret. The planner knows the votes and locations but not the qualities. The planner could also be coded as DES; ORG is chosen because it is listed first.

DES.note: The design role is coded under ORG (the planner).

C7.1.quote: The goal of the planner is now to construct a committee
C7.1.note: ORG (planner) optimises its choice; VOT (experts) report rankings mechanically by perceived quality.

C7.2.note: No argument is given for why experts are non-strategic while the planner optimises.
